title: Universal Declaration, Article 3: life, liberty, and security of person
summary: The United Nations text of Article 3, from the declaration proclaimed on 10 December 1948.
body: The United Nations page of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights gives Article 3. In short: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person. The core pack records the proclamation and Article 1. This card is Article 3. The declaration is what the General Assembly proclaimed as a common standard. The UN page opened here does not describe it as a treaty that states ratify.

sources.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
sources.author: United Nations General Assembly
sources.note: Text page opened 2026-11-18. Resolution 217 A, proclaimed in Paris on 10 December 1948.
